_comment: Page copy for about.html. Edited through the CMS at /admin. tools/build-pages.js writes these values back into the HTML at deploy time, so the text stays crawlable.
page__p-1: Ty's Future Stars Foundation was established to honor the life and legacy of Tykeem D'Majh Franklin by investing in the dreams, education, and development of young athletes.
page__p-2: Ty's Future Stars Foundation empowers youth through basketball, education, mentorship, and scholarship opportunities in honor of Tykeem D'Majh Franklin. Through community support and athletic development, we strive to help student-athletes reach their full potential both on and off the court.
page__p-3: To create opportunities that inspire the next generation of student-athletes to succeed academically, grow as leaders, and build brighter futures through the game of basketball.
page__h2-3: Investing in dreams, education, and development.
page__p-4: Ty's Future Stars Foundation was established to honor the life and legacy of Tykeem D'Majh Franklin by investing in the dreams, education, and development of young athletes.
page__p-5: The foundation is committed to providing scholarships, mentorship, and positive opportunities that encourage youth to pursue success in academics, athletics, and life.
page__p-6: We encourage young people to lead with confidence, integrity, and purpose in their schools, communities, and daily lives.
page__p-7: We believe education creates opportunities and empowers youth to build successful futures beyond athletics.
page__p-8: We promote hard work, dedication, accountability, and perseverance both on and off the court.
page__p-9: We are committed to strengthening our communities through mentorship, service, and positive youth engagement.
page__p-10: We strive to remove barriers and provide resources that help student-athletes achieve their goals and maximize their potential.
page__p-11: We honor Tykeem D'Majh Franklin's memory by continuing to inspire, uplift, and invest in future generations.
founder__p-1: LaSonya Adams is a wife, mother of four, proud “GiGi” to eight grandchildren, and a leader whose faith and love for family inspire her commitment to serving others.
founder__p-2: She founded Ty's Future Stars Foundation in 2021 to honor her son, Tykeem “Ty” D'Majh Franklin, whose life was tragically taken by gun violence on July 16, 2020, just two days before his 24th birthday. Ty loved deeply and wholeheartedly, especially when it came to his family, friends, and those he held close. His big heart, love of basketball, and natural ability to bring people together continue to inspire the foundation's work. Through TFSF, LaSonya chose to turn her grief into a legacy of hope and opportunity for young people.
founder__p-3: With more than 20 years of healthcare leadership experience, LaSonya brings a strong background in mentoring, developing leaders, and guiding teams toward meaningful results. As a senior executive and entrepreneur, she carries that same dedication into the foundation's work through scholarships, mentorship, athletics, leadership development, and community outreach.
founder__p-4: Her commitment also extends to supporting families through community give-back initiatives such as Ty's Turkey Giveaway and Toys for Ty's Stars, bringing encouragement and assistance to communities in Alabama and Tennessee.
founder__p-5: At the heart of LaSonya's work is a simple belief: every young person deserves to feel seen, supported, and capable of building a brighter future. Through TFSF, she honors her son's memory by extending the kind of love he gave so freely and investing in the lives and dreams of others.
founder__p-6: Building Futures One Bounce at a Time.
page__blockquote-1: "She believes faith, love, and purpose can transform pain into legacy and is committed to helping others live with compassion, strength, and hope."
page__h2-6: Be part of the next chapter.
page__p-15: Whether you give, volunteer, or partner with us, there's a place for you in this mission.
spotlights__p-1: Recognition, writing, and outreach from the work LaSonya is doing in Ty's name.
